user_manual.detail: Documents message receipt migration, original-preserving size fallback, and delivery/queue limitations for instance operators. Configurable direct-user priority, validated gateway metadata and bounded priority bursts are documented.

reusable_learning.detail: The existing wake-completion-contract already requires consumer acknowledgements and reconciliation of uncertain sends. This bounded regression fix documents its behavior and limits in the existing role-wake guide instead of adding another general procedure.

architecture_fit.original_request: Prevent repeated wake inputs from disrupting role sessions and prepare the shared upstream fix.
architecture_fit.parent_structure: The shared Naia ADK role wake registry, per-role durable delivery receipts, routed wake boxes and delivery-time work headers.
architecture_fit.acceptance_rationale: Extend the existing handover and receipt path while preserving shared routing, remote-box delivery and work-header selection. Instance credentials, service controls and model choices stay outside the patch. Priority is an optional registry configuration using the existing grouping and handover boundary, with an empty default for other installations.
